snippet.title: CultGame | Official Found Footage Trailer
snippet.description:
WISHLIST CULTGAME ON STEAM: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2345980/CultGame/

CultGame is a cult simulator RPG where you start a cult in a procedurally generated dark fantasy world with haunting ASCII art.

Credits:
Meshach Malley - Writer, Director, Camera Work, Editing (https://gentleembersmedia.com/)
Jeff Stevens - Writer, Executive Producer, Chefjeff (https://bucephalusstudios.com/about.html)
Marco Montoto - Production Assistant 
Gavin Hamrick - anprim_anon
Mazellmi - Additional Sound Design (https://www.youtube.com/@mazellmi)
